主要内容: BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT INC. issued $350 million in Senior Unsecured Notes due June 2, 2026, with a trade date of May 25, 2016. The notes have a coupon rate of ·%, with interest payments on June 2 and December 2, starting December 2, 2016. The price to public and yield are undisclosed due to regulatory restrictions. The notes include a make-whole call provision prior to March 2, 2026, and a par call at 100% of principal from March 2, 2026. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include BAMACN.
